atoms.b: Twice a week, I play ((football)) with my team, and sometimes we have games at the weekend too. It is so much fun! Sometimes I play ((table tennis)) with my friend Jordan which I also really like.

What I don't like is ((tennis)), because I can never hit the ball. When I was little I started ((ballet)), but I wasn't very flexible, so I didn't want to do it anymore. Once, I tried ((basketball)) with some friends and I liked it a lot. I hope we will do that again in the future.
I train three times a week.
atoms.sound: To prepare for a competition, I train three times a week

atoms.b: and he always wants us to win.
atoms.sound: Our coach is ambitious and he always wants us to win
